lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in a series of vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. These columns typically contain 3 to 5 nodes, forming a semi-regular grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a lattice-like arrangement of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and a defined shadow cast on the ventral side.
